purpose: Teach: 大木/所沢/野原/大輔/中西/大津/大平/大江

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自宅の庭の大木を眺めるのがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that regular customer of yours loves watching the big tree in their garden.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Speaking as if sharing a small, noticed detail. Warm and gentle. Slight pause before delivering the fact, like Mei is recalling it with care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、埼玉県所沢にお住まいだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they live in Tokorozawa, Saitama, don't they?
lines.style: Quieter than before. Matter-of-fact but still connected—not listing facts, but noticing them together. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様達と野原で遊ばれるのがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer loves spending time with their children playing in the fields.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Slower pace. A small smile in the voice—something genuine and family-centered. Trailing softly, like she's pleased by the image.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の大輔くんと一緒にご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they came in with their grandson Daisuke, remember?
lines.style: Warmer now, more present. A slight lift of affection—remembering a specific, real visit. Inviting Mei to recall it with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お友達の中西さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they were having tea with their friend Nakanishi.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. Not performing—just recalling something observed. Even pacing. The voice of someone who notices who comes in together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、滋賀県大津のご出身だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they're from Otsu, Shiga, originally.
lines.style: Straightforward, informative. Clear delivery on the place names. Slight curiosity underneath—the detail of where someone is from.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大平総理の時代のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they told you about the time when Ohira was Prime Minister.
lines.style: Impressed, gentle. Slight reverence for the detail—this person carries memory. Warm respect. A small pause before 'Ohira' like it matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大江健三郎先生の文学を愛されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they really love Oe Kenzaburo's writing.
lines.style: Appreciative and sincere. A note of genuine respect for the customer's taste. Softer attack. Trailing gently, like this detail rounds out the picture of who they are.
